title: Derive evidence-based class labels for Jev scoring
summary: Add an evidence-derived labeling path that writes append-only class-label records (labeler "evidence", with a basis citing record ids) from three kinds of later evidence: retry outcome after the proposed request/prevention, class recurrence after prevention, and critic/verifier findings naming the same cause. Cases without evidence stay unlabeled, a person's review label always wins, and score-jev reports the derived count and a score and verdict if at least 10 test rows exist. The audience is the maintainer running athena score-jev.

defaults_applied.how: Fixture-record tests per evidence kind, plus cargo test and clippy clean.
Criteria check labels produced with basis, and precedence, by running tests and score-jev.
Zero derived labels is reported as such, never as a passing score.
Run score-jev on the repository's records.
CHANGELOG and decisions entry written for outside readers.
Labels come from outcomes, not from Jev's own answers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Labeler gains an evidence-derived variant and ClassLabel gains an optional basis field (list of cited record ids with the evidence kind), backward compatible with existing records.
Derivation runs from a CLI step (a flag on athena score-jev or a subcommand) that appends labels not already derived, so reruns are idempotent.
Precedence is implemented in newest_labels/build: any person or stronger-model label beats an evidence label regardless of time.
Where evidence kinds conflict, the case is left unlabeled rather than guessed.
Derived labels are real records written to records/ on this repository's run; the score-jev result is reported honestly even if under 10 test rows (no verdict then).
Derivation logic may live in a new module in athena-core if introspect.rs/jev.rs would become too large.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run cargo test: a fixture-record test shows each of the three evidence kinds (retry outcome, recurrence after prevention, critic/verifier same-cause findings) yielding a class-label with evidence-derived labeler and a basis citing the record ids it rests on.
Run cargo test: a fixture introspection with no evidence gets no label and counts as unlabeled.

Run cargo test: when both a person label and an evidence label exist for one introspection, the person label is used by the labeled set, whichever is newer; and derivation never edits or deletes an existing record, and rerunning does not duplicate labels.

Run cargo run -- score-jev on this repository's records: output states how many labels were derived from evidence (and per evidence kind) and, if the test part has at least 10 rows, a score and verdict; otherwise states the shortfall with no verdict.

ClassLabel schema and docs/records.md-relevant schema tests accept old labels without a basis and round-trip new ones; CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md record the evidence-derived labeling call and its alternatives.
cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check are clean.

out_of_scope: Changing the MIN_TEST_CASES threshold or scoring formulas
Changing athena review's own flow beyond precedence
departures: Larger than the typical job: schema change, three derivation rules, precedence, CLI, and a run on real records, so higher cost, longer time, and lower pass probability.
hard_reason: Changes the class-label record schema and label precedence that the score-jev gate reads to judge Jev.
